name: Chemistry, Ph.D. / Combined Master's & Doctoral
department: College of Natural Sciences — Department of Chemistry

deadline.value: Fall 2027 International Admissions Guide has not yet been published by SNU Office of Admissions (Spring 2027 international online application ran July 6-9, 2026).

gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for Chemistry (ETS discontinued the GRE Chemistry Test in May 2023).
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Chemistry Test was discontinued in May 2023.

supervisor.value: Department FAQ explicitly states pre-admission faculty contact is only informational and not required for admission; admitted students select a supervisor after matriculation interviews.
supervisor.quote: We remind any interested student that the pre-admission contact is only to provide information. The pre-admission contact will not be considered as a necessary step for admission. | After admission, students can choose their supervisors after interview with faculty members.

funding.value: Department guarantees full financial support for graduate students covering tuition, fees, housing, and living expenses (all graduate students complete one chemistry lab TAship and one regular class TAship).
funding.quote: The school of chemistry guarantees full financial support for graduate students. The support includes tuitions and fees, housing, and living expenses.

entry_route.value: Accepts both bachelor's holders (Combined Master's & Doctoral course) and master's holders (Doctoral program).
entry_route.quote: 1) Master’s / Combined Master’s & Doctoral Programs: a bachelor’s degree or higher | Combined Master’s and Doctoral Course is available to applicants who wish to obtain a Ph.D. degree without a master’s degree. Applicants must have a bachelor’s degree or higher and should apply for the Combined Master’s and Doctoral Course. | Chemistry ◯ ◯ ◯

toefl_min.value: Department FAQ states all applicants must meet minimum Chemistry English proficiency score of TOEFL iBT 86 or higher (TEPS 327 or higher on the old/new scale listed).
toefl_min.quote: All applicants for the graduate school must submit the English proficiency test score such as TOEFL, IELTS, and TEPS. For successful admission to Chemistry, the test score should meet the minimum requirements. Currently, the minimum requirements are 86 or higher for TOEFL (IBT) and 327 or higher for TEPS.

english_waiver.value: Chemistry FAQ explicitly states all applicants must submit an English proficiency test score (TOEFL, IELTS, or TEPS), stricter than SNU's central medium-of-instruction exemption.
english_waiver.quote: All applicants for the graduate school must submit the English proficiency test score such as TOEFL, IELTS, and TEPS.

notes: Department FAQ contains a minor typo printing tuition as '38 M KRW (~ 3500 USD) per semester' (central Appendix 2 lists KRW 3,971,000 per semester for Natural Sciences excluding Mathematical Sciences). Note Interdisciplinary Program in Biophysics and Chemical Biology and WCU/CALS Applied Life Chemistry also offer related tracks.
